name: Missed dock window recovery brief
summary: The dispatch supervisor gets one brief when a truck misses its dock appointment and the reports disagree: each stated arrival time, the receiving cutoff, the appointment record and the questions that need a decision. It contacts no one and books nothing.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own design, written from its published map of logistics work: an appointment record and a log of reports in set layouts that stop on a mismatch; every stated arrival time kept and measured in minutes against the window end and the cutoff; the latest report from each source compared; a cutoff that differs from the record shown beside it; acceptance of a late arrival counted as confirmed only when it comes from the receiver; fee terms quoted from the record and never calculated; and a fixed set of questions for the dispatch supervisor.
